description: Optimierung und Ausbaumöglichkeiten von Fernwärmesystemen is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltbundesamt.at. The expansion of district heating is envisaged as an important measure to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, increase energy efficiency and increase the share of renewable energy in environmental policy programmes. Achievable effects depend on the technology and efficiency of each generation plant and its interconnection, fuel used, distribution losses and use. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Optimisation and expansion of district heating systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energie, OpenDocument. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
